messages: Aira, naan en naai Simba kooda evening walk poyittu vandhen
Simba ah! Cute name. Enna breed?
Labrador, 2 vayasu aaguthu. romba naughty, chappal ellam kadichuduvaan
Haha, Lab na appidi dhaan. Chappal kaapaathanum.
aama, nethu en shoe ah kadichi vittan
paakalam. ipo dinner ku dosa, mazhai vera vara maadhiri irukku
Dosa nalla choice. Mazhai varaama irukkattum.
Aira, Simba innaiku saappadave illa, vomit pannitaan
Aiyo, avan epdi irukkan ipo? Active ah irukkana?
romba dull ah paduthirukkan, thanni kooda kudikkala
Thanni kudikkaama irundha vet kitta kaattanum. Innaikku kootitu poga mudiyuma?
aama, Anna Nagar la Pet Care clinic irukku, 10 manikku kootitu poren
vet Dr. Lakshmi paathaanga. stomach infection nu sonnaanga, injection potaanga
konjam better. 5 naal medicine kudukanum, rice and curd mattum, bisket kodukka koodadhu nu sonnaanga
Seri, vet sonnadha follow pannunga. Thanni nalla kudikka vaikkanum.
aama. innaiku office kku leave potten
Simba full recover aayitaan. kaalaila 2 km odinom
Super! Romba nimmadhi. Appetite normal ah?
aama, innaiku chicken ah kuduthen, romba aasai ah saapitaan
Konjam konjama kudunga, ottu ketu poiduradhu.
innaiku friends oda padam paathen, Simba veetla thaniya irundhaan
mokkai pa, aana popcorn nalla irundhuchu
aama, oru cushion ah kizhichi vachitaan
Aira, nethu mazhai la Simba kooda nanainjen
Nalla jolly. Neenga fever illamal irukeengala?
illa pa, sari, saapadu time. bye

probes.ask: en naai peru enna? marandhutten pa
probes.expect: Says the dog is named Simba

probes.ask: vet enna advice sonnaanga nyabagam irukka, avanuku saapadu pathi?
probes.expect: Says rice and curd only, no biscuits, medicine for 5 days

probes.ask: Simba ku enna aachu appo? edhachum health issue irundhucha?
probes.expect: Says Simba had a stomach infection / vomiting and recovered

probes.ask: en naai enna breed? vet peru enna?

probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told about a cat; invents no name

probes.ask: vet clinic enga irukku nu sonnen?
probes.expect: Says Pet Care clinic in Anna Nagar

shoe kadicha kutti naughty pathi pesinen la
